analogy.rationale: Hedgehog pathway inhibitors act on Smoothened or downstream GLI, so smoothened receptor antagonists and GLI antagonists should phenocopy the response; however, these cell lines have low Hedgehog pathway activity, so the overall transcriptional effect should be weak, with unrelated nuclear receptor agonists serving as low-similarity negative controls.
